notes.title: Slitherise is now on sale for the first time!
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting Slitherise!
We’re excited to announce our first-ever sale – 20% off for a limited time!
If you’re curious about guiding a glowing serpent through the depths of a mysterious world, now’s the perfect chance.

Slitherise 1.0.3 Update Notes
Handle Area Adjustment
Fixed an issue where the snake could get stuck between the gear and the floor, potentially causing a soft lock. This possibility has been eliminated.

Pause Screen Improvement
Added a warning to the "Return to Title" button indicating that progress will not be saved, to prevent accidental data loss.
